# nvts

NVTs and NVT families.

- Toolset name: `nvts`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 3 (3 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_get_nvt`

**Get NVT** · read-only

Get one NVT by OID, including tags and solution details.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `oid` | string | yes | NVT OID, e.g. `1.3.6.1.4.1.25623.1.0.100315` |

### `openvas_list_nvt_families`

**List NVT families** · read-only

List NVT families with their test counts. Pagination only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_search_nvts`

**Search NVTs** · read-only

Browse the NVT (vulnerability test) catalog with typed selectors: by family, by scan config, with preferences, sorted. For free-text search across findings use openvas_list_results with a filter.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `config_id` | string | no | Restrict to the NVTs selected by this scan config |
| `family` | string | no | Restrict to one NVT family, e.g. "Web Servers" |
| `include_preference_count` | boolean | no | Include each NVT's preference count |
| `include_preferences` | boolean | no | Include preference definitions and values |
| `include_timeout` | boolean | no | Include the special timeout preference (requires config_id) |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |
| `preferences_config_id` | string | no | Resolve preference values from this scan config |
| `sort_field` | string | no | Backend NVT field used for sorting, e.g. "name" or "cvss_base" |
| `sort_order` | string | no | Backend sort direction: ascending or descending |
